I'm Marquise Fleming, a Lead Product Designer currently at ABM Industries.

With experience across diverse industries including technology, beverages, and enterprise solutions, I bring a unique perspective to every design challenge.

My journey has taken me through companies like Y Media Labs, Province Brands of Canada, and The Creative Momentum, where I've honed my craft in creating user-centered digital experiences.

I believe in the power of thoughtful design to solve complex problems and create meaningful connections between users and products.

Philosophy

How I Approach Design

01

User-Centered

Every design decision starts with understanding the people who will use the product. Research and empathy drive my process.

02

Purpose-Driven

Design without purpose is decoration. I focus on solving real problems and creating measurable impact.

03

Collaborative

Great design emerges from great collaboration. I work closely with stakeholders, developers, and users throughout the process.

04

Iterative

Design is never finished. I embrace feedback, testing, and continuous improvement to refine and perfect solutions.
